title: Evolve on Graph: Self-Evolving Knowledge Graph Reasoning without Question Annotations
abstract: arXiv:2610.35598v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide reliable external knowledge for multi-hop factual reasoning with large language models (LLMs), yet most KGs in real-world domains such as finance and industry lack question--answer (QA) annotations. Without such annotations, existing methods struggle to improve LLM graph reasoning: training-free agents cannot improve their exploration through interaction; reinforcement learning (RL) agents depend on QA data annotated by humans or synthesized by closed-source models; and training data is typically built offline, so its topology mix is fixed and cannot follow the agent's ability. We propose Evolve on Graph (EoG), a framework that lets an LLM self-evolve its graph reasoning without any QA annotations. Through Graph Self-Play, a single LLM alternates between a Proposer that poses questions and a Solver that answers them. translated_title: 图上演化：无需问题标注的自演化知识图谱推理
translated_abstract: 知识图谱（KG）为大型语言模型（LLM）的多跳事实推理提供了可靠的外部知识，然而金融、工业等真实领域中的大多数知识图谱缺乏问答（QA）标注。在没有这些标注的情况下，现有方法难以提升大语言模型的图推理能力：免训练的智能体无法通过交互改进其探索策略；强化学习（RL）智能体则依赖人工标注或闭源模型合成的问答数据；而且训练数据通常采用离线方式构建，其拓扑结构分布固定，无法跟随智能体自身能力的变化。我们提出 Evolve on Graph（EoG）框架，使大语言模型能够在没有任何问答标注的情况下自演化其图推理能力。通过图自博弈，单个大语言模型在提出问题的 Proposer 和回答问题的 Solver 两种角色之间交替切换。为了使问题可验证，符号可验证拓扑合成（SVTS）对推理路径进行采样……
tldr: 提出无需任何问答标注的知识图谱推理自演化框架 EoG，通过图自博弈让单个大语言模型在提问者与解答者角色间交替，并借助符号可验证的拓扑合成实现图推理能力的自主提升。
